name: one-to-one-someone-joins
description: A 1:1 invite, but a colleague joins half way and introduces himself.
lines: Hi Imogen, sorry, I've asked Ben to join us for the second half because it's about the vendor contract.
So the short version is the vendor wants a three year term and we'd rather do one year with an option to extend.
Sorry, Ben here, just joining. I've read the draft and the termination clause is the bit I'd push back on.
Thanks Ben. What would you change?
I'd ask for ninety days' notice instead of a hundred and eighty, and no early exit fee after the first year.
That works for me. Ben, can you send them the redline today?
Yes, I'll send it this afternoon.
